# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_data_docs.py; do not edit by hand. -->

Everything the study records, file by file and field by field: the per-episode records written by the
runtime, the sweep-level files written by the launcher, the harbor files the analysis reads, and every
table and column `subagents-bench aggregate` derives. Record fields and their descriptions come from
`subagents_bench/schema.py`; the sweep files and analysis columns were introspected from real output
(the offline pipeline of `tests/offline_pipeline.py`: the real runtime and sweep writers with scripted models).

Conventions:

- Timestamps are `time.time()` epoch seconds (harbor's own files use ISO 8601); durations are seconds.
- Token counts: `prompt_tokens` includes `cached_tokens`; `completion_tokens` includes `reasoning_tokens`.
- Unknown or not observable is `null` in the records and empty/NaN in the CSVs, never a made-up 0.
  An observed zero (a role that made no calls) is 0.
- Roles: `orchestrator`, `subagent`, `arbiter` (judge calls), `debate` (candidates revising their
  reports). CSV columns use the short forms `orch`, `sub`, `arb`, `deb`.
- Costs: the run-time `cost_usd` uses the price table in the run's config (a billed estimate). The
  study's costs are recomputed offline under every scheme of `configs/pricing.yaml`.
- Raw provider data is kept (`usage_raw`, `response_headers`, `attempts`, `chunk_offsets_ms`), so cost
  and latency can be recomputed later under other assumptions.

## Where everything lands

```
jobs/<sweep>/                          # one sweep (scripts/run_experiment.sh)
  sweep.json                           # spec, resolved configs, provenance, invocation history
  sweep_manifest.jsonl                 # one line per job event
  tasks_meta.json                      # task covariates (difficulty, category, expert time, ...)
  preflight.json                       # preflight checks and the per-model test requests
  configs/<condition>.yaml             # the resolved ExperimentConfig of each condition
  <sweep>__r<round>__<condition>/      # one harbor job
    result.json, config.json, job.log  # harbor's
    <task>__<suffix>/                  # one harbor trial
      result.json, config.json, trial.log, verifier/   # harbor's (reward, phases, exception)
      agent/                           # the episode dir: the runtime's records below
        episode.json calls.jsonl tools.jsonl steps.jsonl spawns.jsonl
        dispatches.jsonl arbitrations.jsonl transcript.jsonl
  provenance/                          # source_<sha16>.json per-file hashes; <invocation>.patch uncommitted source
  .sweep.lock                          # held by the running sweep (pid, host, invocation)
  _partial/<job>.{partial,retry}.<k>/  # jobs moved aside on resume: unfinished, or rerun (ignored by analysis)
  _oracle/                             # preflight --oracle feasibility run (ignored by analysis)
analysis/<sweep>/                      # scripts/analyze.sh: the CSVs below + summary.json
figures/<sweep>/                       # PNG + PDF figures and index.md (captions)
```

## Per-episode records (`<trial>/agent/`)

### `calls.jsonl`

One line per LLM call, every role (orchestrator steps, subagent steps, judge calls, debate calls), including calls that failed or were abandoned.

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | str | Episode this call belongs to. |
| `call_id` | str | Unique id of this LLM call. |
| `seq` | int | Global start order of this call within the episode (0-based, shared counter with tools). |
| `role` | str | orchestrator \| subagent \| arbiter (judge call) \| debate (candidate revision call). |
| `agent_id` | str | 'orchestrator', 'sub-<n>', or 'arbiter-<arbitration_id>'. |
| `dispatch_id` | str \| None | Subagent dispatch this call belongs to (subagent/debate roles). |
| `group_id` | str \| None | spawn_subagents group (subagent/arbiter/debate roles). |
| `arbitration_id` | str \| None | Arbitration this call belongs to (arbiter/debate roles, and candidate subagents). |
| `step` | int | Agent-local step number (1-based); for arbiter/debate the round number. |
| `agent_seq` | int | 0-based position of this event in its agent's sequential chain (shared with that agent's tool events; a candidate's debate calls continue its counter). |
| `model` | str | Model id sent to the provider. |
| `provider` | str | Provider key from the config (sail, prime, anthropic, vllm, ...). |
| `base_url` | str \| None | Endpoint base URL. |
| `completion_window` | str \| None | Sail tier sent in X-Sail-Completion-Window (asap/balanced/flex), else None. |
| `max_tokens` | int | max_tokens requested. |
| `temperature` | float | Sampling temperature requested. |
| `extra_body` | dict | Extra request-body params (e.g. reasoning controls). |
| `n_messages` | int | Wire messages in the request, excluding the system prompt (a runtime tool turn with k results counts as k, as a prefix cache sees them). |
| `n_tools` | int | Tool schemas offered. |
| `prompt_chars` | int | Serialized chars of system + messages + tool schemas. |
| `system_hash` | str | sha1[:12] of the system prompt. |
| `tools_hash` | str | sha1[:12] of the serialized tool specs. |
| `msg_hashes` | list | sha1[:12] per serialized wire message (same counting as n_messages), in order, for offline prefix-cache simulation. |
| `msg_chars` | list | Serialized chars per wire message, in order. |
| `reasoning_passback` | bool | Whether prior reasoning text was sent back on assistant turns. |
| `context_trimmed_chars` | int | Chars of older tool output elided by the context guard before this call. |
| `t_start` | float | Call start (before first attempt). |
| `t_end` | float | Call end (after the successful attempt's stream closed). |
| `latency_sec` | float | t_end - t_start, including retries/backoff. |
| `t_request_sent` | float \| None | When the successful attempt's request was sent. |
| `t_headers` | float \| None | When the successful attempt's response headers arrived. |
| `t_first_chunk` | float \| None | First streamed delta of any kind. |
| `t_first_reasoning` | float \| None | First reasoning delta. |
| `t_first_content` | float \| None | First visible content delta. |
| `t_first_tool_call` | float \| None | First tool-call delta. |
| `t_last_chunk` | float \| None | Last streamed delta. |
| `ttft_sec` | float \| None | t_first_chunk - t_request_sent (queue + prefill + first token). |
| `decode_sec` | float \| None | t_last_chunk - t_first_chunk. |
| `n_chunks` | int | Delta-carrying SSE chunks received. |
| `chunk_offsets_ms` | list | Arrival offset (ms from t_request_sent) of each delta chunk, capped at 4096. |
| `streamed` | bool | True if the response was streamed (False for non-streaming clients). |
| `n_attempts` | int | HTTP attempts made (1 = no retries). |
| `backoff_sec` | float | Total time slept between attempts. |
| `attempts` | list | Per-attempt [{attempt,t_start,t_end,status,error_type,error,retry_after_sec,backoff_sec}]. status is the HTTP status received (a stream that broke after the headers keeps it, e.g. 200 with error_type ReadError) and None only when no response arrived; count transport failures by error_type. |
| `prompt_tokens` | int | Provider-reported prompt tokens (includes cached). |
| `completion_tokens` | int | Provider-reported completion tokens (includes reasoning). |
| `cached_tokens` | int | Prompt tokens served from the provider's prefix cache (0 also when the provider does not report caching; usage_raw tells the two apart). |
| `uncached_prompt_tokens` | int | prompt_tokens - cached_tokens. |
| `reasoning_tokens` | int \| None | Reasoning tokens, if the provider breaks them out. |
| `usage_source` | str | 'provider'; 'estimated' (ceil(chars/4) when the provider sent no usage); 'none' (the call failed or was abandoned: nothing was reported and the usage fields are 0). |
| `usage_raw` | dict \| None | The provider's usage object verbatim. |
| `finish_reason` | str | Provider finish reason (stop, tool_calls, length, ...); 'unknown' if the stream ended with [DONE] but no finish_reason; 'error' for a failed or abandoned call. |
| `n_tool_calls` | int | Tool calls in the response. |
| `tool_call_names` | list | Names of the tool calls, in order. |
| `content_chars` | int | Visible content chars. |
| `reasoning_chars` | int | Reasoning chars. |
| `response_id` | str \| None | Provider response id (SSE chunk 'id'). |
| `response_headers` | dict | Response headers (cookies removed). |
| `cost_usd` | float \| None | Cost from the config price table at run time (billed estimate); None if the config has no price. The study recomputes cost offline per pricing scheme. |
| `price_in` | float \| None | USD / 1M uncached input tokens used for cost_usd (None = not configured). |
| `price_out` | float \| None | USD / 1M output tokens used for cost_usd (None = not configured). |
| `price_cache_read` | float \| None | USD / 1M cached input tokens used for cost_usd (None -> price_in). |
| `provider_reported_cost` | float \| None | Cost field from the provider's usage object, verbatim (untrusted). |
| `error` | str \| None | Set if the call ultimately failed ('<ExceptionType>: message') or was abandoned when the episode stopped ('cancelled: ...'); usage fields are then 0. |
| `stream_repairs` | int \| None | Repairs the client made to the streamed tool calls of this response: repeated argument deltas and duplicate calls dropped plus clashing call ids renamed (Sail re-sends a complete tool call under a second index). 0 normally; None for a failed call. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |

Each element of `attempts`:

| key |  | description |
|---|---|---|
| `attempt` |  | 1-based attempt number within the call. |
| `t_start` |  | Attempt start (epoch s). |
| `t_end` |  | Attempt end (epoch s). |
| `status` |  | HTTP status received; a stream that broke after the headers keeps it (e.g. 200); None only when no response arrived. |
| `error_type` |  | None on success; else RateLimited, ServerError, Billing, ContextLength, ReadError, ConnectError, TruncatedStream, StreamError, StreamParseError, ... (count transport failures by this, not by status). |
| `error` |  | Truncated error body or message. |
| `retry_after_sec` |  | Server-provided Retry-After (seconds), if any. |
| `backoff_sec` |  | Sleep taken after this attempt before the next one (0 on the last attempt). |

### `tools.jsonl`

One line per tool invocation, including the runtime's own tools (finish, submit, spawn_subagents).

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | str | Episode id. |
| `tool_event_id` | str | Unique id of this tool invocation. |
| `seq` | int | Global start order (shared counter with calls). |
| `role` | str | Role of the agent that invoked the tool. |
| `agent_id` | str | Agent that invoked the tool. |
| `dispatch_id` | str \| None | Subagent dispatch (None for the orchestrator). |
| `group_id` | str \| None | spawn group of the invoking subagent; for spawn_subagents, the group it created. |
| `arbitration_id` | str \| None | Arbitration of the invoking candidate subagent, if any. |
| `step` | int | Agent-local step in which the tool was requested. |
| `agent_seq` | int | Position in the agent's sequential chain. |
| `call_id` | str | LLM call that requested this tool. |
| `tool_call_id` | str | Provider's tool_call id. |
| `name` | str | Tool name; the runtime's own tools are recorded too: finish, submit and spawn_subagents (whose duration is the time the orchestrator blocked on its group). |
| `args` | dict | Tool arguments (string values over 4000 chars truncated with a marker). |
| `t_start` | float | Tool start. |
| `t_end` | float | Tool end. |
| `duration_sec` | float | t_end - t_start. |
| `exit_code` | int \| None | Shell exit code for bash/search/etc.; None for non-shell tools. |
| `timed_out` | bool | True if the command hit its timeout. |
| `timeout_sec` | int \| None | Timeout applied to the command (None for non-shell tools). |
| `output_chars_raw` | int | Chars of output before truncation. |
| `output_chars_returned` | int | Chars returned to the model. |
| `truncated` | bool | Whether output was truncated. |
| `is_error` | bool | Whether the tool result was flagged as an error to the model. |
| `error` | str \| None | Error message, if any. |
| `cwd_before` | str \| None | bash: working directory before the command. |
| `cwd_after` | str \| None | bash: working directory after the command. |
| `n_exec` | int | Number of environment exec round-trips this tool made. |
| `exec_sec` | float | Seconds spent inside environment exec calls (rest is harness overhead). |

### `steps.jsonl`

One line per orchestrator step (one LLM call plus the tools it requested).

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | str | Episode id. |
| `step` | int | Orchestrator step (1-based). |
| `call_id` | str \| None | The orchestrator LLM call of this step (None if the call failed). |
| `t_start` | float | Step start (before the LLM call). |
| `t_end` | float | Step end (after all of the step's tools finished). |
| `duration_sec` | float | t_end - t_start. |
| `llm_sec` | float | Seconds in the orchestrator LLM call. |
| `tools_sec` | float | Seconds executing the step's tools (incl. blocking on subagents). |
| `n_tool_calls` | int | Tool calls requested in this step. |
| `tool_names` | list | Tool names requested, in order. |
| `spawned_group_ids` | list | spawn groups created in this step. |
| `finished` | bool | Whether the orchestrator called finish in this step. |

### `spawns.jsonl`

One line per spawn_subagents call (a group of dispatches).

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | str | Episode id. |
| `group_id` | str | Unique id of this spawn_subagents call. |
| `orchestrator_step` | int | Orchestrator step that issued it. |
| `call_id` | str | Orchestrator LLM call that requested it. |
| `tool_call_id` | str | Provider tool_call id. |
| `strategy` | str | parallel \| sequential \| arbiter. |
| `scope` | str | easy \| medium \| hard (delegation scope -> subagent tool set). |
| `requested` | int | Instructions the orchestrator asked for. |
| `granted` | int | Instructions actually run. |
| `cap_reason` | str \| None | Why fewer were granted: max_concurrent \| max_dispatches \| None. |
| `dispatches_remaining_after` | int | Dispatch budget left after this call. |
| `instructions` | list | All requested instruction strings (granted ones first). |
| `dispatch_ids` | list | Dispatches created (arbiter: all candidates). |
| `arbitration_ids` | list | Arbitrations created (arbiter strategy only). |
| `concurrency` | int | Max subagents allowed to run at once in this group. |
| `t_start` | float | Group start. |
| `t_end` | float | Group end (all results ready). |
| `duration_sec` | float | t_end - t_start. |
| `sum_dispatch_sec` | float | Sum of member dispatch durations (= serial time). |
| `files_modified` | list \| None | Files under the workdir modified during the group (capped at 200), None if not measured. |
| `n_files_modified` | int \| None | Count of modified files (uncapped), None if not measured. |

### `dispatches.jsonl`

One line per subagent run (arbiter candidates included).

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | str | Episode id. |
| `dispatch_id` | str | Unique id of this subagent run. |
| `agent_id` | str | Subagent id ('sub-<n>'). |
| `group_id` | str | spawn group. |
| `arbitration_id` | str \| None | Arbitration it is a candidate in, if any. |
| `candidate_index` | int \| None | Candidate number within the arbitration (0-based). |
| `instruction_index` | int | Index of its instruction within the spawn call. |
| `orchestrator_step` | int | Orchestrator step that spawned it. |
| `strategy` | str | parallel \| sequential \| arbiter. |
| `scope` | str | easy \| medium \| hard. |
| `model` | str | Subagent model id. |
| `tools` | list | Tool names available to the subagent. |
| `instruction` | str | Full instruction text. |
| `report` | str | Final report returned (submit text, or last text). |
| `status` | str | submitted \| no_tool_call \| max_steps \| context_overflow \| error \| cancelled \| token_budget \| timeout (the last two: a token or wall-clock safety cap was reached before a step). |
| `steps_used` | int | LLM steps taken. |
| `max_steps` | int | Step budget. |
| `t_queued` | float | When the dispatch was created. |
| `t_start` | float | When it began running. |
| `t_end` | float | When it finished. |
| `duration_sec` | float | t_end - t_start. |
| `queue_sec` | float | t_start - t_queued (waiting for a concurrency slot). |
| `n_llm_calls` | int | LLM calls made. |
| `prompt_tokens` | int | Sum of prompt tokens. |
| `completion_tokens` | int | Sum of completion tokens. |
| `cached_tokens` | int | Sum of cached prompt tokens. |
| `reasoning_tokens` | int \| None | Sum of reasoning tokens (None if never reported). |
| `cost_usd` | float \| None | Billed-estimate cost of its calls (None if any call was unpriced). |
| `llm_sec` | float | Seconds in LLM calls. |
| `tool_sec` | float | Seconds in tool calls (submit included; it takes ~0 s). |
| `n_tool_calls` | int | Tool calls made (excluding submit). |
| `tool_counts` | dict | Tool name -> count. |
| `n_tool_errors` | int | Tool results flagged as errors. |
| `n_timeouts` | int | Commands that timed out. |
| `context_trims` | int | Times the context guard elided old output. |
| `workdir` | str | Working directory the subagent started in. |
| `isolation` | str | shared \| copy (private copy of the workdir) \| shared_fallback (copy skipped: too large). |
| `files_modified` | list \| None | Files it modified (edit_file targets + detected changes; capped), None if not measured. |
| `n_files_modified` | int \| None | Count of modified files, None if not measured. |
| `error` | str \| None | Error text if status == error. |

### `arbitrations.jsonl`

One line per arbitrated instruction (arbiter strategy).

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | str | Episode id. |
| `arbitration_id` | str | Unique id. |
| `group_id` | str | spawn group. |
| `instruction_index` | int | Which instruction of the spawn call. |
| `instruction` | str | Instruction text. |
| `n_candidates` | int | Candidates run. |
| `candidate_dispatch_ids` | list | Dispatch ids of the candidates, by candidate index. |
| `isolation` | str | shared \| copy \| shared_fallback. |
| `rounds` | list | Per judge round: {round, judge_call_id, judge_retry_call_id, debate_call_ids, winner, confidence, agreement, rationale, parse_ok, t_start, t_end}. judge_retry_call_id (schema 3; absent in older records): the judge's one retry after a reply cut off at the output limit without a complete judgement, else None; the round's judgement is the better-ranked of the two calls. |
| `debate_rounds_used` | int | Debate rounds actually run (confidence-aware: 0 if the first judgement was confident). |
| `final_winner` | int | Chosen candidate index: the winner of the judgement in final_from_round (0 when no round produced one). |
| `final_confidence` | float \| None | Judge confidence in [0,1] of the judgement used (final_from_round). |
| `agreement` | bool \| None | Judge's verdict on whether candidates agreed, from the judgement used (final_from_round). |
| `applied` | bool | Whether the winner's changes were applied to the real workdir (copy isolation only). |
| `applied_files` | list | Files written/deleted when applying the winner (capped at 200). |
| `apply_error` | str \| None | Error while applying the winner, or while restoring leaked files (prefixed 'restoring leaked files: '), if any. |
| `isolation_sec` | float | Seconds spent before the candidates started on isolation: workdir size check, the workdir's pristine manifest, the base copy and the candidates' private copies (~0 for shared). |
| `t_start` | float | Candidates start (after isolation setup). |
| `t_candidates_end` | float | All candidates finished. With copy isolation, the leak check and restore, mapping copy paths back to the workdir path inside the copies, and the judge's diff summaries happen between this and rounds[0].t_start. |
| `t_end` | float | Final judgement, apply and private-copy cleanup finished. |
| `duration_sec` | float | t_end - t_start (isolation_sec is not included). |
| `isolation_violated` | bool \| None | Copy isolation only: whether files in the real workdir changed while the candidates ran (other than files a concurrent arbitration of the episode applied meanwhile), i.e. a candidate wrote the real workdir instead of its copy (or a process started before the arbitration, e.g. a server logging there, kept writing it). Those changes were undone (restored from the base copy) before the winner was applied, unless the restore failed (apply_error then starts with 'restoring leaked files: '). Changes outside the workdir are not checked. None for shared/shared_fallback isolation or when the check could not run. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `leaked_files` | list | The real-workdir files behind isolation_violated (absolute paths, capped at 200; modified, added or deleted while the candidates ran, then restored). (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `n_path_remaps` | int | Candidate tool calls whose arguments named the real workdir and were redirected to the candidate's private copy (a file tool's path, or occurrences in a bash command); summed over the candidates, 0 without copy isolation. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `final_from_round` | int \| None | Judge round whose judgement was used: the latest round with a complete judgement (parse_ok), else the latest with a parseable winner. A later round whose judge call failed or whose reply did not parse never replaces it. None when no round produced a winner (final_winner is then the fallback 0). (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |

Each element of `rounds`:

| key |  | description |
|---|---|---|
| `round` |  | Judge round (1 = first judgement; each later round follows one debate round). |
| `judge_call_id` |  | CallRecord of this round's judge call (role arbiter). |
| `debate_call_ids` |  | CallRecords of the debate calls that preceded this judgement (empty in round 1). |
| `winner` |  | 0-based candidate index the judge picked in this round (0 when unparseable, the call failed or the round was aborted). The arbitration's final_winner can come from an earlier round (final_from_round). |
| `confidence` |  | Judge confidence in [0, 1]; None when unparseable. |
| `agreement` |  | Judge's verdict on whether the candidates agreed; None when unparseable. |
| `rationale` |  | Judge's rationale text ('judge call failed: ...' when the call failed). |
| `parse_ok` |  | Whether a complete judgement was parsed (tool call, or JSON in the text); False for a failed or aborted round. |
| `t_start` |  | Round start (before its debate calls, if any). |
| `t_end` |  | Round end (judge call finished). |

### `transcript.jsonl`

Every message every agent saw or produced, in order (system prompts, instructions, assistant turns with reasoning and tool calls, tool results as the model saw them).

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | str | Episode id. |
| `agent_id` | str | Agent whose context this message is in. |
| `role` | str | Role of that agent. |
| `dispatch_id` | str \| None | Dispatch id for subagents. |
| `index` | int | Message index in that agent's context (system prompt = 0). A debate call is a separate context under the candidate's agent_id with role 'debate', and its index restarts at 0 each debate round. |
| `t` | float | When the message was appended. |
| `message_role` | str | system \| user \| assistant \| tool. |
| `content` | str \| None | Text content (tool results: the text the model saw). |
| `reasoning` | str \| None | Assistant reasoning text, if any. |
| `tool_calls` | list | [{id,name,arguments}] for assistant turns. |
| `tool_results` | list | [{call_id,content,is_error}] for tool turns. |
| `call_id` | str \| None | LLM call that produced this assistant message. |

`tool_calls` elements: `id` Provider tool_call id.; `name` Tool name.; `arguments` Arguments object as parsed.

`tool_results` elements: `call_id` tool_call id answered.; `content` Text the model saw.; `is_error` Flagged as an error to the model.

### `episode.json`

One per episode. Written at start with `status: running`, rewritten at the end with `status: done` and every aggregate computed from the JSONL files (so a crash leaves a `running` record).

| field | type | description |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | int | Record schema version. |
| `status` | str | running \| done (rewritten at the end). |
| `episode_id` | str | Unique id of this episode. |
| `experiment` | str | config.name (the condition). |
| `config` | dict | Full resolved ExperimentConfig. |
| `config_hash` | str | sha1[:12] of the canonical config JSON. |
| `strategy` | str \| None | parallel \| sequential \| arbiter; None for topology=single. |
| `scope` | str \| None | easy \| medium \| hard; None for topology=single. |
| `topology` | str | single \| subagents. |
| `orchestrator_model` | str | Orchestrator model id. |
| `subagent_model` | str \| None | Subagent model id (None for single). |
| `arbiter_model` | str \| None | Arbiter model id (arbiter strategy only). |
| `task_name` | str | Task name (harbor task_name, or the local task id). |
| `trial_name` | str \| None | harbor trial name (task__suffix). |
| `harbor_session_id` | str \| None | harbor agent session id. |
| `harbor_trial_id` | str \| None | harbor trial UUID (agent context_id). |
| `logs_dir` | str | Directory these files were written to. |
| `instruction` | str | Full task instruction given to the orchestrator. |
| `harness_version` | str | subagents_bench.__version__. |
| `git_commit` | str \| None | Harness git commit (HEAD of the repo holding the package); None outside a git work tree (e.g. a ZIP or tarball copy) or when that work tree tracks none of the package (a copy unpacked inside an unrelated repository). |
| `git_dirty` | bool \| None | Uncommitted changes to tracked harness source (subagents_bench/, configs/, scripts/, pyproject.toml, uv.lock; untracked files and other paths are ignored); None outside a git work tree. Use source_sha256 to tell code versions apart. |
| `source_sha256` | str \| None | Fingerprint of the harness source that ran: sha256 over the sorted (path, sha256 of contents) of subagents_bench/, configs/, scripts/, pyproject.toml and uv.lock, uncommitted and untracked files included (subagents_bench.provenance.source_fingerprint). Equal values = identical code, with or without git; computed once per process, when harbor imports the agent (local runs: at the first episode). Analysis-only files (subagents_bench/analysis/, plots/, sweep.py, cli.py, configs/, scripts/: provenance.NON_RUNTIME_PATHS) are included, though no episode uses them. None if it could not be computed. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `harbor_version` | str \| None | Installed harbor version. |
| `python_version` | str | Python version. |
| `host_platform` | str | platform.platform() of the host. |
| `host_machine` | str | platform.machine() of the host (e.g. arm64). |
| `container_arch` | str \| None | uname -m inside the container (x86_64 on an arm64 host = emulated). |
| `sandbox_kind` | str | harbor \| local_docker \| local_shell \| exploitbench. |
| `workdir` | str | Resolved working directory in the container. |
| `has_timeout_binary` | bool \| None | Whether coreutils `timeout` exists in the container (in-container kill of runaway commands). |
| `t_start` | float | Episode start. |
| `t_end` | float \| None | Episode end. |
| `wall_clock_sec` | float \| None | t_end - t_start. |
| `t_first_call` | float \| None | First LLM call start. |
| `exit_reason` | str \| None | finished \| max_steps \| no_tool_call \| token_budget \| timeout \| cancelled \| billing_error \| provider_error \| error. provider_error: an orchestrator LLM call failed with a provider error after all retries (see n_provider_errors); under harbor the agent then raises ProviderUnavailableError, so the verifier is skipped. |
| `error` | str \| None | Traceback/message for exit_reason in (error, billing_error, provider_error): '<ExceptionType>: message' (the message carries the HTTP status when there was one); harbor's cancel note for cancelled. |
| `cancel_kill` | dict \| None | Set only when harbor cancelled the agent: the best-effort kill of the agent's still-running in-container commands, run after the cancel grace wait and before the verifier. {attempted: a kill exec was sent, ok: it completed, n_killed: commands whose process group/tree was killed, error: why it failed or None}. None when there was no cancel. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `final_summary` | str \| None | Orchestrator's finish summary (or last text). |
| `orchestrator_steps` | int | Orchestrator LLM steps taken. |
| `spawn_calls` | int | spawn_subagents calls. |
| `dispatches` | int | Subagent runs (arbiter candidates included). |
| `redispatches` | int | Dispatches from the 2nd and later spawn calls. |
| `arbitrations` | int | Arbitrations run. |
| `requested_total` | int | Sum of requested instructions. |
| `granted_total` | int | Sum of granted instructions. |
| `instruction_following` | float \| None | Mean granted/requested over spawn calls (None if no spawns). |
| `n_calls` | dict | role -> LLM call count. Every dict keyed by role has the four keys orchestrator, subagent, arbiter, debate. |
| `n_tool_calls` | dict | role -> tool call count (finish, submit and spawn_subagents included). |
| `tokens` | dict | role -> {prompt, completion, cached, uncached_prompt, reasoning}; reasoning is None if never reported. |
| `cost_usd` | dict | role -> billed-estimate USD, plus 'total'; a value is None if any of its calls was unpriced. |
| `llm_sec` | dict | role -> summed LLM call seconds. |
| `tool_sec` | dict | role -> summed tool seconds (the orchestrator's includes the time blocked in spawn_subagents). |
| `n_retries` | int | Extra HTTP attempts across all calls. |
| `n_stream_repairs` | int | Sum of calls.jsonl stream_repairs: streamed tool-call repairs across all calls (0 normally). (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `backoff_sec` | float | Total retry backoff sleep. |
| `n_provider_errors` | int | LLM calls of any role that failed with a provider error after all retries: a plain LLMError, not a BillingError or ContextLengthError (retries exhausted, a non-retryable 4xx such as 401/403, a missing API key); their calls.jsonl error starts with 'LLMError:' (telemetry.is_provider_error, which also works on older records). Over 0 means a provider failure touched the episode (a subagent dispatch that failed this way has status error), so the trial does not measure the condition. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `n_command_timeouts` | int | Commands that hit their timeout. |
| `n_context_trims` | int | Context-guard trims across all agents. |
| `harness_exec_n` | int \| None | Environment exec round-trips the harness made for its own measurements (workdir markers, modified-file scans, git diff --stat), None if not counted. |
| `harness_exec_sec` | float \| None | Wall-clock seconds during which at least one of those measurement execs ran (the union of their intervals: concurrent ones, e.g. parallel dispatches' markers and scans, count once). They belong to no agent's chain, so they show up in overhead_sec. Before schema_version 3 this was the plain sum (now harness_exec_sum_sec). |
| `harness_exec_sum_sec` | float \| None | Summed seconds of those measurement execs (concurrent ones counted in full); >= harness_exec_sec. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `files_modified` | list \| None | Files under the workdir modified during the episode (capped at 500), None if not measured. |
| `n_files_modified` | int \| None | Count (uncapped), None if not measured. |
| `git_diff_stat` | str \| None | `git diff --stat` in the workdir if it is a git repo. |
| `reward` | float \| None | Verifier reward; None until joined. |
| `resolved` | bool \| None | reward == 1; None until joined. |

Each value of `tokens` (per role):

| key |  | description |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` |  | Prompt tokens (cached included). |
| `completion` |  | Completion tokens (reasoning included). |
| `cached` |  | Cached prompt tokens. |
| `uncached_prompt` |  | prompt - cached. |
| `reasoning` |  | Reasoning tokens; None if the provider never broke them out. |

## harbor's files (read by the analysis)

harbor 0.24.0 writes `result.json` per trial and per job. The analysis reads these trial fields:

| field | use |
|---|---|
| `task_name` | Task. |
| `trial_name` | `<task>__<suffix>`. |
| `verifier_result.rewards.reward` | Verifier reward (1.0 = solved) -> episodes.csv reward/resolved. |
| `exception_info.exception_type / occurred_at` | harbor-level exception -> harbor_exception, validity. |
| `environment_setup / agent_setup / agent_execution / verifier .started_at/.finished_at` | Phase timestamps -> env_setup_sec, agent_setup_sec, agent_exec_sec, verifier_sec. |
| `started_at / finished_at` | Whole trial -> trial_total_sec. |
| `agent_result` | harbor's AgentContext as filled by the agent: n_input_tokens, n_cache_tokens, n_output_tokens, cost_usd, model_usage per model, metadata (the episode summary). Redundant with episode.json; not read by the analysis. |

The sweep launcher reads the job `result.json` (`n_total_trials`, `stats.n_completed_trials`, `n_errored_trials`, `n_running_trials`, `n_pending_trials`, `finished_at`) to decide whether a job is complete.

## Sweep-level files (`jobs/<sweep>/`)

### `sweep_manifest.jsonl`

One line per job event, appended as the sweep runs.

| key | description |
|---|---|
| `sweep` | Sweep name. |
| `job` | Job name `<sweep>__r<round>__<condition>` (= harbor --job-name and the job dir). |
| `round` | Round number (1-based). |
| `condition` | Condition name. |
| `event` | run \| skipped_complete \| moved_partial \| retried \| duplicate_trials \| interrupted \| provider_abort. `retried`: a finished job with trials to rerun was moved aside before its rerun; `duplicate_trials`: the job dir holds more trials than one harbor run makes, so it was not run; `provider_abort`: the sweep stopped on a provider outage (`reason` names the failing models and errors). Consumers take outcomes from the job's last `run` line. |
| `cmd` | The `harbor run` argv. |
| `config_path` | Materialized resolved config (`<jobs_dir>/configs/<cond>.yaml`). |
| `t_start` | Event start (epoch s). |
| `t_end` | Job end (epoch s); None for non-run events. |
| `duration_sec` | t_end - t_start. |
| `return_code` | harbor's exit code. |
| `n_trials` | Trials in the job (harbor n_total_trials). |
| `n_completed` | Finished trials (harbor counts errored trials as completed). |
| `n_errors` | Errored trials. |
| `complete` | Whether the job counts as complete (see DESIGN section 5). |
| `status_reason` | Why the job is in its state (`run`, `retried` and `duplicate_trials` lines). |
| `n_episode_json` | Trial dirs with agent/episode.json. |
| `billing_error_trials` | Trials whose episode ended in a billing error (the sweep aborts). |
| `git_commit` | Harness commit (HEAD) when the job started. |
| `state` | Job state after the run (`run` lines): complete \| needs_retry (finished, but a trial did not measure the condition) \| partial \| duplicate. See DESIGN section 5. |
| `retry_trials` | trial -> reasons it must be rerun: billing, provider (a model call failed after all retries), infrastructure (harbor failed outside the agent), agent_exception (the agent raised and the verifier never ran). On `run` lines the trials of that run; on `retried` lines those of the job moved aside. |
| `n_provider_error_trials` | Trials of the run with a provider failure (`run` lines). The sweep stops (exit 4) when such a trial is followed by a failed probe of the models (`provider_abort` line). |
| `invocation_id` | The sweep.json invocation that ran the job (`run` lines). |
| `tasks` | Tasks the job ran (`run` lines). |
| `harbor` | harbor settings the job ran with (`run` lines): env, n_concurrent, agent_timeout_multiplier, extra_args. |
| `source_sha256` | Fingerprint of the harness source when the job started (`run` lines; subagents_bench.provenance.source_fingerprint, as episode.json source_sha256). |
| `git_dirty` | Tracked harness source differed from git_commit when the job started (`run` lines). |
| `moved_to` | Where the job dir was moved (`moved_partial` and `retried` lines). |
| `reason` | Why the sweep stopped (`provider_abort` lines): the trial or job with the provider failure, and each model that still failed the probe request with its error. |

### `sweep.json`

Rewritten at the start and end of every sweep invocation.

| key | description |
|---|---|
| `sweep_json_version` | Format version of this file. |
| `name` | Sweep name. |
| `status` | Outcome of the latest invocation: running \| complete \| incomplete (a job failed or still needs a retry) \| interrupted \| aborted_billing \| aborted_provider (a provider failure, and the models still failed a probe request) \| aborted_code_change (code that episodes run changed mid-sweep) \| aborted_failures. |
| `jobs_total` | Jobs in the whole sweep (rounds x conditions). |
| `jobs_complete` | Of those, complete. |
| `spec_path` | Sweep spec file. |
| `spec_files` | sha256 of the spec and every file in its `extends` chain. |
| `base_config` | Base ExperimentConfig file. |
| `base_config_sha256` | Its sha256. |
| `spec` | The spec after `extends` resolution. |
| `dataset` | harbor dataset name@version. |
| `tasks` | Task names of the latest invocation (every invocation's are under `invocations`). |
| `rounds` | Rounds. |
| `order_seed` | Seed of the per-round condition shuffle. |
| `condition_order` | round -> condition order used. |
| `conditions` | condition -> {config_path, config_sha256} of the materialized resolved config. |
| `provider_tiers` | Distinct (model, provider, completion_window) used. |
| `harbor` | harbor settings: env, n_concurrent, agent_timeout_multiplier, extra_args, agent import path, executable. |
| `jobs_dir` | Jobs dir. |
| `tasks_meta_path` | tasks_meta.json path. |
| `manifest_path` | sweep_manifest.jsonl path. |
| `provenance` | Provenance of the latest invocation: invocation_id, date (UTC), source_sha256 (fingerprint of the harness source: subagents_bench, configs, scripts, pyproject.toml, uv.lock), git_commit, git_dirty (tracked source files differ from it), untracked_source_files, python_version, python_executable, harbor_version, harbor_executable, lockfile, lockfile_sha256, host_platform, host_machine, docker (`docker info` summary: server_version, architecture, ncpu, mem_total_bytes), argv; a sweep run adds source_files_record (`provenance/source_<sha16>.json`: per-file sha256) and source_patch (`provenance/<invocation_id>.patch`: `git diff HEAD` plus the untracked source files, which `git apply` restores on a checkout of git_commit; None when the source matches git_commit). |
| `source_sha256s` | Distinct harness source fingerprints the sweep's jobs ran with (their last manifest `run` lines and every episode.json source_sha256). An edit to files no episode uses (subagents_bench/analysis/, plots/, sweep.py, cli.py, configs/, scripts/: provenance.NON_RUNTIME_PATHS) adds an entry too. |
| `mixed_source` | True if the fingerprints in source_sha256s hold more than one version of the code under test, i.e. their provenance/source_<sha16>.json records differ in a file episodes use (a fingerprint without a record counts as different). Edits confined to analysis, plots, the launcher, scripts or configs do not set it. A resume refuses runtime differences unless --allow-code-change. |
| `mixed_git_commits` | True if the invocations recorded more than one git commit (see mixed_source, which also sees uncommitted changes). |
| `invocations` | History: one provenance record (the provenance keys plus status, only, rounds, tasks, harbor, n_ran, n_skipped, n_failed) per invocation. |

### `tasks_meta.json`

| key | description |
|---|---|
| `dataset` | harbor dataset name@version. |
| `source_dir` | Where the task definitions were read. |
| `generated_at` | When the file was written (UTC). |
| `tasks` | task name -> metadata (below), for every task the sweep has run (a task dropped from the spec keeps its entry for its trials). |

Per task:

| key | description |
|---|---|
| `difficulty` | Terminal-Bench difficulty label (easy/medium/hard). |
| `category` | Task category. |
| `expert_time_min` | Expert time estimate (minutes). |
| `junior_time_min` | Junior time estimate (minutes). |
| `agent_timeout_sec` | task.toml agent timeout (harbor multiplies it by agent_timeout_multiplier). |
| `verifier_timeout_sec` | task.toml verifier timeout. |
| `docker_image` | Prebuilt task image, if any. |
| `tags` | task.toml tags. |

### `preflight.json`

Written by `subagents-bench preflight` (not part of the offline introspection).

| key | description |
|---|---|
| `spec` | Sweep spec checked. |
| `date` | When (UTC). |
| `dotenv` | {path, keys: {name: set\|kept\|overridden}}; never the values. |
| `docker` | `docker info` summary (local Docker only). |
| `harbor` | {executable, version}. |
| `requests` | One tiny streaming request per distinct (model, provider, tier): model, provider, completion_window, ok, latency_sec, ttft_sec, streamed, n_chunks, n_attempts, finish_reason, prompt/completion/cached/reasoning tokens, usage_source, text_chars (or error_type, error). |
| `oracle` | `--oracle`: {job_dir, reused (an earlier oracle job that passed on every task), return_code, moved_partial_to (where an unfinished, failing or --redo-oracle job was moved), mean_reward, failing_tasks, trials}. |
| `checks` | [{name, ok, detail, required}] as printed. |
| `passed` | Every required check passed. |

### `configs/<condition>.yaml`

The fully resolved `ExperimentConfig` of each condition (every default explicit); see `docs/DESIGN.md` section 2 and `subagents_bench/config.py`. The same dict is stored in each `episode.json` under `config`, with its hash in `config_hash`.

## Analysis tables (`analysis/<sweep>/`)

Written by `subagents-bench aggregate` (DESIGN section 6). Every table is written, header only when empty.

Pricing schemes in this output: `sail_balanced`, `sail_asap`, `sail_flex`, `prime`, `reference`. Serving profiles: `measured`, `fitted`, `roofline_h100`. Column sets that repeat per scheme, profile or role follow the same pattern for any other scheme or profile configured.

### `episodes.csv`

One row per trial (harbor trial, or bare local episode): design, task covariates, outcome and validity, harbor phases, counts, tokens by role, cost under every pricing scheme, FLOPs, time, the measured critical path and simulated wall time under every serving profile.

| column | description |
|---|---|
| `sweep` | Sweep name (from the job name, else sweep.json, else the jobs dir name). |
| `job_name` | harbor job (`<sweep>__r<round>__<condition>`); empty for bare episode dirs. |
| `round` | Round (from the manifest, else the job name). |
| `condition` | Condition name (manifest, else job name, else the episode's config name). |
| `trial_name` | harbor trial name `<task>__<suffix>`. |
| `task_name` | Task name. |
| `episode_id` | Episode id (episode.json). |
| `topology` | single \| subagents. |
| `strategy` | parallel \| sequential \| arbiter (empty for single). |
| `scope` | easy \| medium \| hard delegation scope (empty for single). |
| `orchestrator_model` | Orchestrator model id. |
| `subagent_model` | Subagent model id (empty for single). |
| `arbiter_model` | Judge model id (arbiter strategy only). |
| `max_concurrent` | Max subagents live at once. |
| `n_candidates` | Candidates per arbitrated instruction (arbiter only). |
| `orchestrator_steps_budget` | Orchestrator step budget. |
| `orchestrator_tools` | The orchestrator's own tools: `all` (default) or the `tools.orchestrator_tools` list joined by `+` (e.g. `read_file+list_dir+search` for a manager orchestrator that must delegate commands and edits). |
| `difficulty` | Terminal-Bench difficulty label (tasks_meta.json). |
| `category` | Task category (tasks_meta.json). |
| `expert_time_min` | Expert time estimate, minutes (tasks_meta.json). |
| `junior_time_min` | Junior time estimate, minutes (tasks_meta.json). |
| `reward` | Verifier reward (harbor result.json; local runs: episode.json). |
| `resolved` | 1 if reward == 1, 0 otherwise; a valid trial the verifier could not score counts 0; empty for invalid trials without a reward. |
| `harbor_exception` | harbor exception type, if any. |
| `exit_reason` | Episode exit reason: finished \| max_steps \| no_tool_call \| token_budget \| timeout \| cancelled \| billing_error \| provider_error \| error (provider_error: the provider could not serve the orchestrator; harbor then records ProviderUnavailableError). |
| `valid` | False when the trial does not measure its condition (invalid_reason); verifier exceptions and agent timeouts stay valid (graded, or unsolved). |
| `invalid_reason` | Empty when valid, else the first that applies: no_episode (no episode.json); billing_error; harbor_exception_outside_agent (environment/setup error, CancelledError, or any exception before the agent started); provider_error (the orchestrator could not be served: exit_reason provider_error or harbor ProviderUnavailableError; or any call of any role failed with a provider error, n_provider_errors > 0; records before schema_version 3: exit_reason error with an 'LLMError:' error); agent_exception (the agent itself raised and harbor skipped the verifier: a harness bug or crash; not AgentTimeoutError, after which harbor still grades); no_result (a harbor trial without result.json). |
| `episode_status` | done \| running (crashed before finalizing) \| missing. |
| `duplicate` | True for every trial but one of the same (condition, sweep, task, round): a re-run, or the same sweep aggregated twice. The valid one (else the first by trial name) is kept; duplicates are left out of conditions*.csv and paired.csv. Never set for bare episodes (no round). |
| `env_setup_sec` | harbor environment_setup phase seconds. |
| `agent_setup_sec` | harbor agent_setup phase seconds. |
| `agent_exec_sec` | harbor agent_execution phase seconds. |
| `verifier_sec` | harbor verifier phase seconds. |
| `trial_total_sec` | Whole harbor trial seconds. |
| `wall_clock_sec` | Episode wall-clock (episode.json t_end - t_start). |
| `orchestrator_steps` | Orchestrator LLM steps taken. |
| `spawn_calls` | spawn_subagents calls. |
| `delegated` | 1 if the orchestrator called spawn_subagents at least once (spawn_calls > 0), else 0; empty without an episode. Treatment uptake: a subagents episode with 0 measured only its prompt. |
| `dispatches` | Subagent runs (arbiter candidates included). |
| `redispatches` | Dispatches from the 2nd and later spawn calls. |
| `arbitrations` | Arbitrations run. |
| `n_isolation_checked` | Arbitrations whose copy-isolation leak check ran (ArbitrationRecord.isolation_violated not None; copy isolation only). 0 without arbitrations; empty if the records predate the check (schema_version < 3). |
| `n_isolation_violations` | Arbitrations in which a candidate changed the real workdir instead of its private copy (isolation_violated; the changes were restored before the winner was applied). Empty if the records predate the check. |
| `n_leaked_files` | Real-workdir files those violations changed (sum of len(leaked_files), each capped at 200). Empty if the records predate the check. |
| `instruction_following` | Mean granted/requested over spawn calls (empty without spawns). |
| `dispatch_submitted_frac` | Fraction of dispatches that ended by calling submit. |
| `n_files_modified` | Files under the workdir modified during the episode (uncapped count). |
| `orch_calls` | LLM calls by the orchestrator role. |
| `orch_prompt_tokens` | Prompt tokens of orchestrator calls (cached included). |
| `orch_cached_tokens` | Cached prompt tokens of orchestrator calls. |
| `orch_uncached_prompt_tokens` | Uncached prompt tokens of orchestrator calls. |
| `orch_completion_tokens` | Completion tokens of orchestrator calls (reasoning included). |

| `sub_calls` | LLM calls by the subagent role. |

| `sub_uncached_prompt_tokens` | Uncached prompt tokens of subagent calls. |
| `sub_completion_tokens` | Completion tokens of subagent calls (reasoning included). |
| `sub_reasoning_tokens` | Reasoning tokens of subagent calls (NaN if the provider never reported them; 0 if the role made no calls). |
| `arb_calls` | LLM calls by the arbiter (judge) role. |
| `arb_prompt_tokens` | Prompt tokens of arbiter (judge) calls (cached included). |

| `cost_reference_sub` | USD of subagent calls re-priced under scheme `reference` (configs/pricing.yaml); NaN if a model is unpriced in it. |

| `cost_reference_deb` | USD of debate calls re-priced under scheme `reference` (configs/pricing.yaml); NaN if a model is unpriced in it. |
| `cost_reference_total` | USD of all calls under scheme `reference`; NaN if any model is unpriced in it. |
| `cost_runtime_total` | Sum of the run-time cost_usd the calls logged (config price table); NaN if any call was unpriced. |
| `flops_orch` | FLOPs of orchestrator calls (2 x active params x tokens); NaN if a model's parameters are unknown. |
| `flops_sub` | FLOPs of subagent calls (2 x active params x tokens); NaN if a model's parameters are unknown. |
| `flops_arb` | FLOPs of arbiter (judge) calls (2 x active params x tokens); NaN if a model's parameters are unknown. |
| `flops_deb` | FLOPs of debate calls (2 x active params x tokens); NaN if a model's parameters are unknown. |
| `flops_total` | Sum of flops_<role>. |
| `llm_sec_orch` | Summed latency of orchestrator calls. |
| `llm_sec_sub` | Summed latency of subagent calls. |
| `llm_sec_arb` | Summed latency of arbiter (judge) calls. |
| `llm_sec_deb` | Summed latency of debate calls. |
| `tool_sec_orch` | Summed duration of tools invoked by the orchestrator role (spawn_subagents blocking included). |
| `tool_sec_sub` | Summed duration of tools invoked by the subagent role. |
| `tool_sec_arb` | Summed duration of tools invoked by the arbiter (judge) role. |
| `tool_sec_deb` | Summed duration of tools invoked by the debate role. |
| `backoff_sec` | Total retry backoff sleep. |
| `n_retries` | Extra HTTP attempts over all calls. |
| `n_command_timeouts` | Tool commands that hit their timeout. |
| `cp_total_sec` | Measured critical path: the orchestrator chain with every spawn replaced by its group's critical duration (DESIGN section 6). |
| `cp_orch_llm_sec` | Critical-path seconds in orchestrator LLM calls. |
| `cp_sub_llm_sec` | Critical-path seconds in subagent LLM calls. |
| `cp_arb_llm_sec` | Critical-path seconds in judge and debate calls. |
| `cp_tool_sec` | Critical-path seconds in tools (plus arbiter isolation, diff and apply time; apply runs from the end of the last judge or debate call). |
| `cp_group_sec` | Critical-path seconds inside spawn groups. |
| `overhead_sec` | wall_clock_sec - cp_total_sec: time on no agent's chain. |
| `harness_exec_sec` | Wall-clock seconds of the harness's own measurement commands (markers, modified-file scans, git diff --stat), as the union of their intervals (concurrent ones count once; the plain sum for records before schema_version 3); explains most of overhead_sec. |
| `sub_busy_sec` | Sum of dispatch durations (total subagent work). |
| `parallel_speedup` | sub_busy_sec / cp_group_sec (NaN without dispatches or group time). For arbiter groups the denominator also holds isolation, judging and apply. |
| `sim_measured_wall_sec` | Simulated episode wall time under serving profile `measured` (configs/serving.yaml): the critical path with every LLM call re-timed by the profile and tools kept as measured; equals cp_total_sec. |
| `sim_fitted_wall_sec` | Simulated episode wall time under serving profile `fitted` (configs/serving.yaml): the critical path with every LLM call re-timed by the profile and tools kept as measured. |
| `sim_roofline_h100_wall_sec` | Simulated episode wall time under serving profile `roofline_h100` (configs/serving.yaml): the critical path with every LLM call re-timed by the profile and tools kept as measured. |
| `n_failed_calls` | Calls that failed or were abandoned (error set). |
| `n_provider_errors` | Calls of any role whose error starts with 'LLMError:' (a provider failure after all retries; telemetry.is_provider_error), counted from calls.jsonl so older records count too. Over 0 makes the trial invalid (provider_error). |
| `n_stream_repairs` | Sum of calls.jsonl stream_repairs: tool-call repairs of the streamed responses (Sail's re-sent tool calls dropped, clashing ids renamed). 0 in records written before the field existed. |
| `n_usage_estimated` | Calls whose usage was estimated (provider sent none). |
| `container_arch` | uname -m in the container (x86_64 on an arm64 host = emulated). |
| `host_machine` | Host machine (e.g. arm64). |

### `calls.csv`

calls.jsonl flattened, one row per LLM call, plus the episode keys, the call's cost under every pricing scheme and its FLOPs. Bulky lists are dropped or summarized. (list fields are ';'-joined, dict fields JSON-encoded in the CSV)

| column | description |
|---|---|
| `sweep` | Sweep name (from the job name, else sweep.json, else the jobs dir name). |
| `condition` | Condition name (manifest, else job name, else the episode's config name). |
| `task_name` | Task name. |
| `round` | Round (from the manifest, else the job name). |
| `trial_name` | harbor trial name `<task>__<suffix>`. |
| `episode_id` | Episode id (episode.json). |
| `call_id` | Unique id of this LLM call. |
| `seq` | Global start order of this call within the episode (0-based, shared counter with tools). |
| `role` | orchestrator \| subagent \| arbiter (judge call) \| debate (candidate revision call). |
| `agent_id` | 'orchestrator', 'sub-<n>', or 'arbiter-<arbitration_id>'. |
| `dispatch_id` | Subagent dispatch this call belongs to (subagent/debate roles). |
| `group_id` | spawn_subagents group (subagent/arbiter/debate roles). |
| `arbitration_id` | Arbitration this call belongs to (arbiter/debate roles, and candidate subagents). |
| `step` | Agent-local step number (1-based); for arbiter/debate the round number. |
| `agent_seq` | 0-based position of this event in its agent's sequential chain (shared with that agent's tool events; a candidate's debate calls continue its counter). |
| `model` | Model id sent to the provider. |
| `provider` | Provider key from the config (sail, prime, anthropic, vllm, ...). |
| `base_url` | Endpoint base URL. |
| `completion_window` | Sail tier sent in X-Sail-Completion-Window (asap/balanced/flex), else None. |
| `max_tokens` | max_tokens requested. |
| `temperature` | Sampling temperature requested. |
| `extra_body` | Extra request-body params (e.g. reasoning controls). |
| `n_messages` | Wire messages in the request, excluding the system prompt (a runtime tool turn with k results counts as k, as a prefix cache sees them). |
| `n_tools` | Tool schemas offered. |
| `prompt_chars` | Serialized chars of system + messages + tool schemas. |
| `system_hash` | sha1[:12] of the system prompt. |
| `tools_hash` | sha1[:12] of the serialized tool specs. |
| `reasoning_passback` | Whether prior reasoning text was sent back on assistant turns. |
| `context_trimmed_chars` | Chars of older tool output elided by the context guard before this call. |
| `t_start` | Call start (before first attempt). |
| `t_end` | Call end (after the successful attempt's stream closed). |
| `latency_sec` | t_end - t_start, including retries/backoff. |
| `t_request_sent` | When the successful attempt's request was sent. |
| `t_headers` | When the successful attempt's response headers arrived. |
| `t_first_chunk` | First streamed delta of any kind. |
| `t_first_reasoning` | First reasoning delta. |
| `t_first_content` | First visible content delta. |
| `t_first_tool_call` | First tool-call delta. |
| `t_last_chunk` | Last streamed delta. |
| `ttft_sec` | t_first_chunk - t_request_sent (queue + prefill + first token). |
| `decode_sec` | t_last_chunk - t_first_chunk. |
| `n_chunks` | Delta-carrying SSE chunks received. |
| `chunk_offsets_n` | Number of chunk arrival offsets logged (chunk_offsets_ms, capped at 4096). |
| `chunk_offset_first_ms` | First delta chunk's offset from the request (ms). |
| `chunk_offset_last_ms` | Last delta chunk's offset from the request (ms). |
| `chunk_gap_ms_median` | Median gap between consecutive delta chunks (ms). |
| `chunk_gap_ms_max` | Largest gap between consecutive delta chunks (ms). |
| `streamed` | True if the response was streamed (False for non-streaming clients). |
| `n_attempts` | HTTP attempts made (1 = no retries). |
| `backoff_sec` | Total time slept between attempts. |
| `attempt_statuses` | HTTP status of each attempt, ';'-joined. |
| `attempt_error_types` | error_type of each failed attempt, ';'-joined. |
| `prompt_tokens` | Provider-reported prompt tokens (includes cached). |
| `completion_tokens` | Provider-reported completion tokens (includes reasoning). |
| `cached_tokens` | Prompt tokens served from the provider's prefix cache (0 also when the provider does not report caching; usage_raw tells the two apart). |
| `uncached_prompt_tokens` | prompt_tokens - cached_tokens. |
| `reasoning_tokens` | Reasoning tokens, if the provider breaks them out. |
| `usage_source` | 'provider'; 'estimated' (ceil(chars/4) when the provider sent no usage); 'none' (the call failed or was abandoned: nothing was reported and the usage fields are 0). |
| `finish_reason` | Provider finish reason (stop, tool_calls, length, ...); 'unknown' if the stream ended with [DONE] but no finish_reason; 'error' for a failed or abandoned call. |
| `n_tool_calls` | Tool calls in the response. |
| `tool_call_names` | Names of the tool calls, in order. |
| `content_chars` | Visible content chars. |
| `reasoning_chars` | Reasoning chars. |
| `response_id` | Provider response id (SSE chunk 'id'). |
| `cost_usd` | Cost from the config price table at run time (billed estimate); None if the config has no price. The study recomputes cost offline per pricing scheme. |
| `price_in` | USD / 1M uncached input tokens used for cost_usd (None = not configured). |
| `price_out` | USD / 1M output tokens used for cost_usd (None = not configured). |
| `price_cache_read` | USD / 1M cached input tokens used for cost_usd (None -> price_in). |
| `provider_reported_cost` | Cost field from the provider's usage object, verbatim (untrusted). |
| `error` | Set if the call ultimately failed ('<ExceptionType>: message') or was abandoned when the episode stopped ('cancelled: ...'); usage fields are then 0. |
| `stream_repairs` | Repairs the client made to the streamed tool calls of this response: repeated argument deltas and duplicate calls dropped plus clashing call ids renamed (Sail re-sends a complete tool call under a second index). 0 normally; None for a failed call. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `cost_sail_balanced` | This call's USD under scheme `sail_balanced`; NaN if its model is unpriced in it. |
| `cost_sail_asap` | This call's USD under scheme `sail_asap`; NaN if its model is unpriced in it. |
| `cost_sail_flex` | This call's USD under scheme `sail_flex`; NaN if its model is unpriced in it. |
| `cost_prime` | This call's USD under scheme `prime`; NaN if its model is unpriced in it. |
| `cost_reference` | This call's USD under scheme `reference`; NaN if its model is unpriced in it. |
| `flops` | 2 x active params x tokens for this call (prompt at the prefill, completion at the decode active-parameter count when models.yaml splits them); NaN for an unknown model. |

Not in the CSV (bulky; read the JSONL): `msg_hashes`, `msg_chars`, `chunk_offsets_ms`, `attempts`, `usage_raw`, `response_headers`.

| `t_candidates_end` | All candidates finished. With copy isolation, the leak check and restore, mapping copy paths back to the workdir path inside the copies, and the judge's diff summaries happen between this and rounds[0].t_start. |

| `isolation_violated` | Copy isolation only: whether files in the real workdir changed while the candidates ran (other than files a concurrent arbitration of the episode applied meanwhile), i.e. a candidate wrote the real workdir instead of its copy (or a process started before the arbitration, e.g. a server logging there, kept writing it). Those changes were undone (restored from the base copy) before the winner was applied, unless the restore failed (apply_error then starts with 'restoring leaked files: '). Changes outside the workdir are not checked. None for shared/shared_fallback isolation or when the check could not run. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `leaked_files` | The real-workdir files behind isolation_violated (absolute paths, capped at 200; modified, added or deleted while the candidates ran, then restored). (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `n_leaked_files` | len(leaked_files); empty if the record predates the leak check. |
| `n_path_remaps` | Candidate tool calls whose arguments named the real workdir and were redirected to the candidate's private copy (a file tool's path, or occurrences in a bash command); summed over the candidates, 0 without copy isolation. (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |
| `final_from_round` | Judge round whose judgement was used: the latest round with a complete judgement (parse_ok), else the latest with a parseable winner. A later round whose judge call failed or whose reply did not parse never replaces it. None when no round produced a winner (final_winner is then the fallback 0). (Added in schema_version 3; absent from older records.) |

### `conditions.csv`

One row per condition over its valid episodes (trials flagged `duplicate` left out): resolve rate with a Wilson CI, the task-balanced rate, delegation uptake and the per-protocol resolve rate, mean and bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples, seed 0) of every metric, per-solve cost and time, copy-isolation leaks and max_tokens truncation by role. Cost, FLOPs, simulated-time and reasoning-token means are NaN if any valid episode is NaN (an unpriced model), never averaged over the priced subset. Estimand: every interval treats the trials as independent draws for THESE tasks (their trial-to-trial randomness), not as a sample of Terminal-Bench tasks in general; compare a condition with a baseline through paired.csv (matched trials, McNemar) rather than by interval overlap.

| column | description |
|---|---|
| `condition` | Condition name. |
| `topology` | single \| subagents. |
| `strategy` | parallel \| sequential \| arbiter (empty for single). |
| `scope` | easy \| medium \| hard delegation scope (empty for single). |
| `orchestrator_model` | Orchestrator model id. |
| `subagent_model` | Subagent model id (empty for single). |
| `arbiter_model` | Judge model id (arbiter strategy only). |
| `max_concurrent` | Max subagents live at once. |
| `n_candidates` | Candidates per arbitrated instruction (arbiter only). |
| `orchestrator_steps_budget` | Orchestrator step budget. |
| `orchestrator_tools` | The orchestrator's own tools: `all` (default) or the `tools.orchestrator_tools` list joined by `+` (e.g. `read_file+list_dir+search` for a manager orchestrator that must delegate commands and edits). |
| `n` | Trials. |
| `n_valid` | Valid trials. |
| `n_resolved` | Resolved valid trials. |
| `resolve_rate` | n_resolved / n_valid: pooled over trials (intention to treat: every valid episode, delegated or not). |
| `resolve_ci_lo` | Wilson 95% interval, lower bound. Treats the valid trials as independent Bernoulli draws, so it covers the rate on these tasks (trial-to-trial randomness), not Terminal-Bench as a whole. |
| `resolve_ci_hi` | Wilson 95% interval, upper bound (same estimand as resolve_ci_lo). |
| `n_tasks_valid` | Tasks with at least one valid trial. |
| `resolve_rate_task_balanced` | Mean over those tasks of each task's resolve rate (n_resolved / n_valid per task), so every task weighs the same: unlike resolve_rate it does not shift when invalid trials (e.g. environment failures) remove some of a task's trials in one condition and not in another. A task with no valid trial left drops out of it, so compare n_tasks_valid across conditions. Compare with resolve_rate; the estimand is still these tasks. |
| `n_delegated` | Valid episodes that delegated (episodes.csv delegated == 1). |
| `delegated_frac` | n_delegated / n_valid: treatment uptake (0 for single-topology conditions). A subagents condition near 0 measured mostly its prompt text. |
| `resolve_rate_delegated` | Per-protocol resolve rate: resolved / n_delegated among the valid episodes that delegated (NaN if none did). Not randomized: the episodes that delegate may differ from those that do not. |
| `resolve_delegated_ci_lo` | Wilson 95% interval of resolve_rate_delegated, lower bound. |
| `resolve_delegated_ci_hi` | Wilson 95% interval of resolve_rate_delegated, upper bound. |
| `wall_clock_sec_mean` | Mean of episodes.csv `wall_clock_sec` over valid trials. |

| `length_finish_frac_deb` | Share of debate calls cut off at max_tokens: sum of deb_length_finishes / sum of deb_calls over valid episodes (NaN without such calls). |

### `conditions_by_difficulty.csv`

conditions.csv split by Terminal-Bench difficulty (`unknown` when the task has no metadata).

| column | description |
|---|---|
| `condition` | Condition name. |
| `difficulty` | Terminal-Bench difficulty (conditions_by_difficulty.csv only). |
| `topology` | single \| subagents. |
| `strategy` | parallel \| sequential \| arbiter (empty for single). |
| `scope` | easy \| medium \| hard delegation scope (empty for single). |
| `orchestrator_model` | Orchestrator model id. |
| `subagent_model` | Subagent model id (empty for single). |
| `arbiter_model` | Judge model id (arbiter strategy only). |
| `max_concurrent` | Max subagents live at once. |
| `n_candidates` | Candidates per arbitrated instruction (arbiter only). |
| `orchestrator_steps_budget` | Orchestrator step budget. |
| `orchestrator_tools` | The orchestrator's own tools: `all` (default) or the `tools.orchestrator_tools` list joined by `+` (e.g. `read_file+list_dir+search` for a manager orchestrator that must delegate commands and edits). |
| `n` | Trials. |
| `n_valid` | Valid trials. |
| `n_resolved` | Resolved valid trials. |
| `resolve_rate` | n_resolved / n_valid: pooled over trials (intention to treat: every valid episode, delegated or not). |
| `resolve_ci_lo` | Wilson 95% interval, lower bound. Treats the valid trials as independent Bernoulli draws, so it covers the rate on these tasks (trial-to-trial randomness), not Terminal-Bench as a whole. |
| `resolve_ci_hi` | Wilson 95% interval, upper bound (same estimand as resolve_ci_lo). |
| `n_tasks_valid` | Tasks with at least one valid trial. |
| `resolve_rate_task_balanced` | Mean over those tasks of each task's resolve rate (n_resolved / n_valid per task), so every task weighs the same: unlike resolve_rate it does not shift when invalid trials (e.g. environment failures) remove some of a task's trials in one condition and not in another. A task with no valid trial left drops out of it, so compare n_tasks_valid across conditions. Compare with resolve_rate; the estimand is still these tasks. |
| `n_delegated` | Valid episodes that delegated (episodes.csv delegated == 1). |
| `delegated_frac` | n_delegated / n_valid: treatment uptake (0 for single-topology conditions). A subagents condition near 0 measured mostly its prompt text. |
| `resolve_rate_delegated` | Per-protocol resolve rate: resolved / n_delegated among the valid episodes that delegated (NaN if none did). Not randomized: the episodes that delegate may differ from those that do not. |

| `length_finish_frac_arb` | Share of arbiter (judge) calls cut off at max_tokens: sum of arb_length_finishes / sum of arb_calls over valid episodes (NaN without such calls). |
| `length_finish_frac_deb` | Share of debate calls cut off at max_tokens: sum of deb_length_finishes / sum of deb_calls over valid episodes (NaN without such calls). |

### `paired.csv`

Each condition vs each baseline condition (default single_5step, single_matched), matched on (sweep, task, round) over valid, non-duplicate episodes (pairs are formed within a sweep; rounds restart at 1 in every sweep).

| column | description |
|---|---|
| `condition` | Condition compared. |
| `baseline` | Baseline condition. |
| `n_pairs` | (sweep, task, round) cells where both have a valid, non-duplicate trial. |
| `both` | Pairs both solved. |
| `only_cond` | Pairs only the condition solved. |
| `only_base` | Pairs only the baseline solved. |
| `neither` | Pairs neither solved. |
| `resolve_rate_cond` | Condition's resolve rate over the pairs. |
| `resolve_rate_base` | Baseline's resolve rate over the pairs. |
| `delta_resolve` | (only_cond - only_base) / n_pairs. |
| `mcnemar_p` | Exact two-sided McNemar p-value (binomial on the discordant pairs). |

### `calibration.csv`

Provider latency per (model, provider, completion_window) over successful calls. The joint call-time fit (`lat_fit_*`) feeds the `fitted` serving profile; the TTFT fit and decode rate are descriptive.

| column | description |
|---|---|
| `model` | Model id. |
| `provider` | Provider. |
| `completion_window` | Sail tier (empty for other providers). |
| `n_calls` | Successful calls. |
| `n_ttft` | Calls with a TTFT. |
| `ttft_median` | Median ttft_sec. |
| `ttft_p90` | 90th percentile ttft_sec. |
| `n_decode` | Calls with decode_sec > 0 and completion tokens. |
| `decode_tok_s_median` | Median completion_tokens / decode_sec (descriptive; the fitted profile uses lat_fit_*). |
| `ttft_fit_a` | Least-squares intercept of ttft_sec on prompt tokens / 1000 (seconds; descriptive). |
| `ttft_fit_b_per_1k_prompt_tokens` | Least-squares slope (seconds per 1000 prompt tokens; descriptive). |
| `ttft_fit_n` | Points in the fit. |
| `lat_fit_a` | Joint call-time fit used by the `fitted` serving profile: call_sec = lat_fit_a + lat_fit_b_per_1k_prompt * prompt_tokens/1000 + lat_fit_c_per_completion_token * completion_tokens, least squares with every coefficient >= 0, of ttft_sec + decode_sec (else latency_sec - backoff_sec) over successful calls. This is the intercept (seconds per call); NaN with fewer than 2 calls. |
| `lat_fit_b_per_1k_prompt` | Joint fit: seconds per 1000 prompt tokens. |
| `lat_fit_c_per_completion_token` | Joint fit: seconds per completion token. |
| `lat_fit_n` | Calls in the joint fit. |
| `latency_median` | Median call latency_sec (retries included). |
| `prompt_tokens_median` | Median prompt tokens. |
| `completion_tokens_median` | Median completion tokens. |
| `n_retried` | Calls that needed more than one attempt. |

### `summary.json`

Run-level summary written next to the tables.

| key | description |
|---|---|
| `generated_at` | When aggregate ran (UTC). |
| `harness_version` | subagents_bench version. |
| `inputs` | Jobs/trial/episode dirs aggregated. |
| `files` | pricing, serving and models files used (marked missing if absent). |
| `input_sha256` | sha256 of every input file the tables were computed from: pricing.yaml and its includes, serving.yaml and any fitted params_file, models.yaml (None if missing). |
| `analysis_source` | The analysis code that produced the tables: source_sha256 (subagents_bench.provenance.source_fingerprint), git_commit, git_dirty, untracked_source_files (None outside git). |
| `episode_source_sha256` | condition -> distinct EpisodeRecord.source_sha256 of the runtime code that recorded its episodes ('unknown' for records before schema_version 3). The fingerprint covers all source, so an edit to analysis code or configs between jobs also adds a value; the sweep's sweep.json mixed_source says whether the code episodes run differed. |
| `n_trials` | Trials found. |
| `n_with_episode` | Trials with episode.json. |
| `n_valid` | Valid trials. |
| `n_resolved` | Resolved valid trials. |
| `episode_status_counts` | episode_status -> count. |
| `invalid_reason_counts` | invalid_reason -> count. |
| `harbor_exception_counts` | harbor exception type -> count. |
| `exit_reason_counts` | exit_reason -> count. |
| `sweeps` | Sweep names. |
| `conditions` | Conditions, in table order. |
| `baselines` | Baselines present. |
| `rounds` | Rounds present. |
| `tasks` | Tasks present. |
| `tasks_meta` | datasets, n_tasks_with_meta, tasks_without_meta. |
| `pricing` | schemes (provenance meta, models, every price used in USD per 1M tokens {in, cached, out}, models whose cached tokens are charged at the input price), aliases, models_without_price per scheme. |
| `models_without_active_params` | Models with no parameter count (their FLOPs and roofline times are NaN). |
| `serving_profiles` | Serving profiles and their parameters/source. |
| `latency_checks` | measured_replay_max_abs_diff_sec, overhead_frac_median, episodes_overhead_over_10pct, unexplained_overhead_frac_median, episodes_unexplained_overhead_over_10pct (overhead not explained by harness_exec_sec), unexplained_overhead_sec_min and episodes_overhead_over_explained (overhead_sec - harness_exec_sec below -0.05 s: not clipped, e.g. the summed execs of records before schema_version 3), fitted_vs_measured (per fitted profile and model: n_calls and sum of fitted / sum of measured call time, overall and by completion length 0-99, 100-399, 400+; 1 in-sample means unbiased). |
| `treatment_coverage` | Per subagents condition: strategy, n_episodes, n_delegated, delegated_frac, n_dispatches, n_arbitrations (arbiter only), ok, problem (no episode delegated, or an arbiter condition ran no arbitration). |
| `duplicate_trials` | Trial names flagged duplicate (left out of the condition and paired tables). |
| `table_rows` | Rows per table. |
| `warnings` | Loader warnings (missing files, malformed records), every pricing scheme lacking a price for a model that made calls, duplicate trials, and subagents conditions whose treatment was never exercised. |

## Figures (`figures/<sweep>/`)

`subagents-bench plot` renders the 14 figures of DESIGN section 7 from these tables; `index.md` in the figure dir captions each one and names the columns it uses.
